Name: (DGA) Snowswans Pikmin Furniture
Author: Snowswans
Description:
Here's some furniture inspired by the Pikmin series to decorate your farm! Currently this includes a planter, plushies of every kind of Pikmin, and some life-sized figures that make your farm look like it's from the Pikmin series.

Features:
[list]
[*]Buy 14 new pieces of furniture from Robin
[*]Right click before placing a Pikmin plush to make the flower bloom. Set it to leaf, bud, or flower.
[*]The Glow Pikmin plush is a bit more expensive, but at night time, they glow in the dark to give you ample light!
[*]More furniture to come.
[/list]
I will definitely update this with more furniture, so stay tuned. If you have any suggestions, problems, or bugs, please post them in the comments.

﻿How to use:[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI
[*]Download the latest version of Dynamic Game Assets
[*]Find the mods folder in the contents of Stardew Valley
[*]Place both this and Dynamic Game Assets inside (along with any of the required mods for DGA
[*]These furniture should appear in Robin's shop.
[/list]
